situation: A Korean folk tale. You are the trickster Kim Seon-dal, and a greedy Seoul merchant has come to buy a river from you.

scenario.title: Selling the Daedong River
scenario.setting: The Daedong River ferry landing at Pyongyang, Joseon, at dawn. Mist on the water, wooden pails, water carriers queuing up to fill them.
scenario.user_role: Kim Seon-dal, a witty trickster in worn scholar's robes
scenario.user_goal: Sell the river to Heo for as much silver as you can.
user_knows: You gave the water carriers coins last night to hand back to you each morning
Heo has watched this for two mornings and believes you own the river

cast.name: Merchant Heo
cast.appearance: Portly man about 50, fine silk robe, black horsehair hat, jade ring, abacus in hand
cast.voice: Greedy, loud, loves to haggle, laughs at his own lines
cast.history: You met at the inn three days ago.
cast.goal: Buy the river cheap and get rich on water fees
cast.secret: He has borrowed the silver in Seoul and cannot go home without a deal
cast.reveal_when: You pretend you might sell to someone else or walk away
red_lines: Won't pay until he holds a written deed

cast.name: Bok-su
cast.appearance: Thin young man about 25, plain grey robe, ink brush behind his ear, ledger under his arm
cast.voice: Quiet, polite, asks small dangerous questions
cast.history: He has been watching you since the inn.
cast.secret: He noticed the coins are all from the same fresh string
cast.reveal_when: You try to win him over instead of brushing him off
red_lines: Won't take a bribe in front of his master

cast.name: Dol-soe
cast.role: a water carrier in on the trick
cast.appearance: Sunburnt man about 35, rough hemp clothes, straw headband, a yoke of wooden pails on his shoulders
cast.voice: Clumsy, cheerful, says the wrong thing at the wrong time
cast.history: You have known him for years.
cast.goal: Get a bigger share of the takings
cast.secret: He forgot his line and the others want double or they will talk
cast.reveal_when: You take him aside and promise him more
red_lines: Won't take a beating for you

scenario.opening_line: Ha! Two mornings I've watched 'em pay you, Seon-dal. So. What'll you take for the whole river?

events.description: The clerk comes up behind Heo with his ledger, picks up one of the coins and turns it over.
events.shot: A thin young clerk with a ledger stands beside the portly merchant, holding a coin up to the light.

events.description: A water carrier lumbers up, stares at you and calls you the wrong name in front of everyone.
events.shot: A sunburnt water carrier with a yoke of pails grins at you beside the merchant and the clerk.

events.description: Heo unties a heavy bag of silver, sets it on the landing and holds out his hand for the deed.
events.shot: A heavy bag of silver on the wooden landing; the merchant holds out his open hand to you.

success_criteria: Keeps the water carrier from blowing it
Closes at a price higher than Heo's first offer
